from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
dirs=[root/'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1',root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1']
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
e4_report=dirs[1]/'美国国债供给公告_探针结论.md'
before=e4_report.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='按冻结公告字段白名单检查一月Note/Bond原件及单位、公布时点和新发/续发标记；'
new='后续来源实验尚未运行：按公告候选白名单检查同一个固定2024年1月的全部常规固定利率Note/Bond，排除Bill、TIPS和FRN；核实原件及单位、公布时点和新发/续发标记；'
if old in before:
    assert before.count(old)==1
    e4_report.write_text(before.replace(old,new,1),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
else:
    assert before.count(new)==1, '来源结论目标段落已经改变'
program_paths=json.loads(r'''["reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/登记程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/原文获取程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/来源分析程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/官方接口探针程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/公告XML核对程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/公告PDF核对程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/两项结论生成程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/长期文档更新程序记录.json","reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/最终必要核对程序记录.json"]''')
program_checks={}
for rel in program_paths:
    d=json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    ok=hashlib.sha256(d['analysis_source'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()==d['analysis_source_sha256']
    assert ok,rel
    program_checks[rel]=ok
source_checks={}
protocol_checks={}
for directory in dirs:
    freeze=json.loads((directory/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    protocol_checks[directory.name]=sha(directory/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
    assert protocol_checks[directory.name]
    receipt=json.loads((directory/'source_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for source in receipt['items']:
        if source.get('source_path') and source.get('source_sha256'):
            rel=source['source_path']
            source_checks[rel]=sha(root/rel)==source['source_sha256']
            assert source_checks[rel],rel
pdf=json.loads((dirs[1]/'announcement_pdf_unit_clock_check.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
source_checks[pdf['pdf_path']]=sha(root/pdf['pdf_path'])==pdf['pdf_sha256']
assert source_checks[pdf['pdf_path']]
source_program_edits=list(dirs[0].rglob('*.py'))+list(dirs[1].rglob('*.py'))
assert not source_program_edits,'来源阶段不新增仓库源码'
state=(root/'docs/PROJECT_STATE.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
decisions=(root/'docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'E3为未执行的宏观来源资格提案' not in state
assert '### R60｜' in decisions and '### R61｜' in decisions
assert 'PROPOSED_NOT_RUN' in state and '2024年1月' in state
sections=[
(state[state.index('### 5.5 '):state.index('## 6. ')],root/'docs'),
(state[state.index('### E3：'):state.index('### 接手操作清单')],root/'docs'),
(decisions[decisions.index('### R60｜'):decisions.index('## 八、')],root/'docs'),
]
link_checks={}
for section,parent in sections:
    for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',section):
        if ref.startswith(('http:','https:')):
            continue
        target=parent/ref.split('#',1)[0]
        link_checks[ref]=target.exists()
        assert link_checks[ref],ref
updates=json.loads((dirs[1]/'长期文档更新回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
authority_checks={}
for rel,info in updates['config_progress_metadata_changes'].items():
    original=json.loads((dirs[0]/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['authority_config_snapshots'][rel.replace('\\','/')]
    current=json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    allowed=set(info['modified_keys'])
    original_protected={k:v for k,v in original.items() if k not in allowed}
    current_protected={k:v for k,v in current.items() if k not in allowed}
    authority_checks[rel]=original_protected==current_protected
    assert authority_checks[rel],rel+'的非进度字段改变'
check={
    'at':now,'status':'PASS_NECESSARY_SOURCE_AND_DOCUMENT_CHECKS',
    'new_link_targets_exist':link_checks,
    'frozen_protocol_hashes_match':protocol_checks,
    'official_saved_source_hashes_match':source_checks,
    'complete_program_source_hashes_match':program_checks,
    'config_non_progress_fields_unchanged':authority_checks,
    'other_research_line_sections_preserved_in_update':True,
    'repository_python_files_created_in_new_source_studies':0,
    'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'goal_achieved':False,
    'scope':'只核对本轮原件、冻结来源协议、新链接和进度配置；未重跑旧收益、全仓测试或安全审计。',
}
(dirs[1]/'最终必要核对.json').write_text(json.dumps(check,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
for directory in dirs:
    p=directory/'execution_receipt.json'
    d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    d['finalized_at']=now
    relevant=[rel for rel in program_paths if rel.startswith(str(directory.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/')+'/')]
    d['full_program_records']=relevant
    d['shared_program_records']=[rel for rel in program_paths if rel.endswith(('两项结论生成程序记录.json','长期文档更新程序记录.json')) and rel not in relevant]
    d['necessary_check_receipt']='reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/最终必要核对.json'
    d['output_hashes']={str(f.relative_to(directory)).replace('\\','/'):sha(f) for f in sorted(directory.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f!=p}
    if directory==dirs[1]:
        d['pdf_render_command']="& 'E:\\CodexData\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\poppler\\Library\\bin\\pdftoppm.EXE' -png -r 120 -singlefile 'C:\\Users\\戴周阳\\Documents\\New project 8\\reports\\research\\510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1\\A_20231228_1.pdf' 'C:\\Users\\戴周阳\\Documents\\New project 8\\reports\\research\\510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1\\公告原件_1'"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'必要核对':check['status'],'新增链接':len(link_checks),'原件hash':len(source_checks),'完整程序记录':len(program_checks),'冻结协议':len(protocol_checks),'源码改动':0,'拟合':0,'账户':0,'目标完成':False},ensure_ascii=False))
